title: enactic/openarm
abstract:
A fully open-source humanoid arm for physical AI research and deployment in contact-rich environments.

# OpenArm **OpenArm** is an open-source 7DOF humanoid arm designed for physical AI research and deployment in contact-rich environments. With high backdrivability and compliance, it is built with safe human-robot interaction in mind while delivering practical payload capabilities for real-world applications. **OpenArm Cell** (on the right) is a standardized environment with unified background, lighting, and camera placement. Research performed using OpenArm can be reproduced around the world in consistent evaluation conditions, facilitating the global discussion on state of the art physical AI research. OpenArm features **human-scale** proportions, safety and compliance, and practical payloads. At $6,500 USD for a complete bimanual system, it provides a flexible platform for teleoperation, imitation learning, simulation, and real-world data collection in contact-rich tasks. *We're in continuous development and actively seeking contributors, research partners, and company collaborators to shape the next generation of practical humanoid systems. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出开源7自由度人形臂OpenArm，强调高可反驱与柔顺性，并配套标准化OpenArm Cell环境，支持遥操作、模仿学习、仿真和真机数据采集。


# 一、动机

> 物理AI研究在接触富集环境下缺乏安全柔顺、高可反驱、低成本且可复现的开源人形机械臂平台与统一评测条件。


# 二、方法

> 提出开源7自由度人形臂OpenArm，强调高可反驱与柔顺性，并配套标准化OpenArm Cell环境，支持遥操作、模仿学习、仿真和真机数据采集。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 完整双臂系统售价6500美元；机械臂为7自由度，具备人尺度比例与实用负载能力；OpenArm Cell统一背景、光照和相机布局，使全球研究可在一致条件下复现评测。


# 四、对我的启发

> 项目偏硬件与生态建设，摘要未给出接触富集任务的量化性能指标，长期效果依赖社区维护与适配；对具身智能中的遥操作、数据采集和可复现评测有参考价值。
